description: This file defines the `LoggerLoggingEvent` class, representing a logging event in the log4php PHP logging framework. It includes properties for log level, message, timestamp, caller location, and methods for retrieving and handling this data.

classes.name: LoggerLoggingEvent
classes.description: Represents a logging event within the framework, encapsulating details such as the logger name, level, message, timestamp, and caller location information.

methods.name: LoggerLoggingEvent
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a logging event with the specified class name, logger object or name, level, message, and optional timestamp.

methods.name: getLocationInformation
methods.description: Collects and returns the location info of where the log was generated, using debug_backtrace.

methods.name: getLevel
methods.description: Returns the log level of the event.

methods.name: getLoggerName
methods.description: Returns the name of the logger associated with this event.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Returns the original message or its rendered form.

methods.name: getNDC
methods.description: Retrieves the nested diagnostic context associated with the event.

methods.name: getMDC
methods.description: Retrieves a specific MDC value by key.

methods.name: getRenderedMessage
methods.description: Returns the message rendered as a string, using registered renderers if available.

methods.name: getStartTime
methods.description: Static method that returns the timestamp when the logging system started.

methods.name: getTimeStamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the event.

methods.name: getThreadName
methods.description: Returns the thread or process name under which the event was generated.

methods.name: getThrowableInformation
methods.description: Returns null; placeholder for throwable info if applicable.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Serializes the object; mainly intended for debugging.
